- %d : day as 2 digits, zero-padded (01..31)

- %_d: day as 1 or 2 digits, no padding (1..31)     [optional token]
- %% : literal percent sign

All other characters in format-string are copied verbatim.

Output

- If wrong number of arguments is provided, print usage to stderr and exit non-zero.

Extensibility
-------------
- The above tokens represent the minimal supported set. Future extensions may add month names (%b, %B), weekday tokens, timezone handling, and time components.
